title: Little Koi v2
desc: The new Little Koi. Every koi dreams of becoming a dragon: grow from a 10 cm koi in the Pond through the River, the Sea and the Ocean, and leap the Dragon Gate. Beat your record and spend your pearls in the Shop.
note: New version of Fish · 4 levels, then a dragon · pearl shop · rooms with friends

title: Fish
desc: You start as a 10 cm koi. Eat the smaller fish, run from the bigger ones, and become the biggest fish in the pond.
note: 4 waters, levels and koi patterns · rooms with friends

title: Rüzgâr Kaptanı
desc: A step-by-step sailing school: tiller, points of sail, sheets, tacking, gybing and the spinnaker, then a race around the course.
note: 8 lessons and free sailing · race friends on the course · in Turkish

title: SONGbox
desc: Line up characters on the stage and each one plays its own beat. Get your song scored and unlock new singers.
note: Make your own character · song contest with friends

title: Sur Muhafızı
desc: Build walls on the road, set up archers, ice wizards and catapults. Hold the castle against goblins, orcs and giants for 20 waves.
note: 20 waves · 5 buildings · see who gets furthest with friends · in Turkish

title: Sekme
desc: Pull the ball back, let go and bounce it off the walls to hit the target. Five chapters, fifty levels; fewer shots, more stars.
note: 50 levels · star race with friends · in Turkish

title: Kar Savaşı
desc: In the snowy forest the neighbourhood kids come at you from every side. Grab snowballs from the snow piles, pull back like a slingshot, throw, and last through the waves. You can also play back to back with friends in the same forest.
note: On your own or with up to 8 friends · in Turkish

title: Kanyon
desc: Fly your jet over the river in the canyon. Refuel at the yellow tanks, hit the ships and helicopters, and knock down the bridge at the end of each stretch.
note: On your own or with friends on the same river · in Turkish

title: Tank Arenası
desc: Everyone is a tank and every hit is a point. A paintball battle against bots or with friends in the same arena; take three hits and you're painted and start again from your corner.
note: 2–8 tanks · with bots or friends · in Turkish

title: Balon Yarışı
desc: Every right answer lifts your balloon: reach 1000 metres before the bot! Adding, subtracting, multiplying and dividing, each with its own levels.
note: From 9 to 40 years old · against a bot or friends · in Turkish

title: Karınca Yolu
desc: Send ants out from your nest and take over the grey and red nests. The more ants walk a path, the brighter the trail and the faster your ants run on it. Plus fights on the road, and the odd sugar cube or apple.
note: 8 levels · two players on one screen · in Turkish

title: Kış Uykusu Oteli
desc: The forest animals spend the winter asleep in your hotel. Tuck in whoever drops their blanket, roll over the snoring bear, shoo the woodpecker, keep the stove in the green. In spring the good sleepers pay in hazelnuts and you grow the hotel.
note: Hotel tycoon · two players on one screen · in Turkish

title: Drawing Board
desc: Build a machine that gets the ball into the bucket, with ramps, springs, pistons, fans, doors, magnets, flippers, bumpers, balloons, scissors and gears. While it runs, the orange devices are yours to press; add a sensor and it runs by itself.
note: 41 drawings · guided start · by hand or fully automatic · two players on one screen

title: Kelime Düellosu
desc: Change one letter of the word that comes to you and send it back before your time runs out. Send a word with no way out and the point is yours. First to 5 wins.
note: Two players face to face on one screen, on two phones, or against the bot · Turkish and English

title: Vagon Defteri
desc: The notebook we made so my dad can draw on his phone on the train. The pen tip stays above your finger, shaky lines fix themselves when the train jolts, and every stop starts a new page.
note: For phones · Marmaray stops · experiment · in Turkish

title: Kış Uykusu Oteli · new look
desc: A first look at the hotel for the iPad version, made with Godot: lit rooms, the red cabin, snow and the northern lights. Tuck in the blankets, feed the stove, catch the falling nuts.
note: Look test for the iPad · experiment · in Turkish
